name: Grilled Chicken Breast with Sweet Potato
description: Seasoned grilled chicken breast served with roasted sweet potato cubes and steamed broccoli. High protein, completely lactose-free and gluten-free.

description: Fluffy egg white omelet stuffed with seasoned shredded chicken breast, tomatoes, and herbs. Light, fast, high-protein, and dairy-free.

name: Creamy Four-Cheese Fettuccine
description: Fresh artisanal fettuccine tossed in a rich parmesan, gorgonzola, mozzarella, and provolone cream sauce.

description: Two 100g smashed beef patties, double cheddar cheese, crispy bacon, and house smoky mayo on a brioche bun.

name: Chickpea & Quinoa Power Bowl
description: Roasted spiced chickpeas, organic tri-color quinoa, avocado slices, cherry tomatoes, and lemon-tahini dressing. 100% vegan and lactose-free.

name: Salmon Poke Bowl
description: Fresh diced salmon, sushi rice, edamame, cucumber, sesame seeds, and soy-ginger glaze. Naturally dairy-free and rich in omega-3.

name: Traditional Carbonara
description: Spaghetti with cured pork guanciale, fresh eggs, pecorino romano cheese, and black pepper. [WARNING: Restaurant is currently closed for maintenance]

name: Nutella Volcano Brownie
description: Fudgy chocolate brownie filled with a liquid hazelnut spread core. [ALLERGEN WARNING: May contain traces of peanuts and tree nuts]

description: Diced chicken wok-tossed with peanuts, vegetables, chili peppers, and savory soy sauce. [ALLERGEN WARNING: Contains peanuts and soy]

name: Crispy Beef Tacos (Promo)

name: Super Green Detox Juice
description: Cold-pressed juice made with kale, green apple, cucumber, lemon, and ginger. Refreshing and sugar-free.

name: Truffle Mushroom Angus Burger
description: 180g Angus beef patty, Swiss cheese, sautéed wild mushrooms, and black truffle aioli on a potato bun.

description: Thin layers of zucchini substituted for pasta, filled with lean ground turkey, homemade tomato sauce, and light mozzarella.

description: Fermented dough, San Marzano tomato sauce, fresh mozzarella di bufala, basil leaves, and extra virgin olive oil.

name: Traditional Feijoada Box

description: Moist sponge cake made with organic cocoa, coconut oil, and flaxseed. 100% plant-based and dairy-free.

name: Turkey & Swiss Whole Grain Sandwich

name: Greek Grilled Lamb Gyro
description: Tender spiced lamb slices wrapped in warm pita bread with tzatziki sauce, red onions, and tomatoes.
